Work in partnership with study teams during periodic file reviews and audits to address findings related to the TMF. Manage access and organization of the controlled electronic file repository, in line with the defined file structure and access management framework. Work proactively and successfully within a cross-functional team. Communicate and promote department and company goals and practices. Interact with stakeholders in a way that fosters a positive working atmosphere and encompasses a professional and helpful attitude. Time allocated may be adjusted based on need. Service Delivery Serve as the primary TMF contact for assigned studies. Ensure TMF is complete and “inspection ready” throughout study lifecycle and documents are filed contemporaneously. Work with Team Lead to create study specific TMF management and oversight documents (e.g., File Index, Expected Document Lists and TMF Management Plan) in alignment with study. Develop and maintain study-specific work instructions, as needed. Utilize organization skills to maintain a quality control schedule and perform periodic inventories of study TMF to ensure completeness. Review and communicate out-of-scope and/or incomplete documents to study teams; escalating as needed. Reconcile expected document lists based on study events and milestones. Prioritize and resolve TMF help desk tickets; may include triaging activities. Provide study specific TMF training to internal and/or external stakeholders, as needed. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Access
jobs.description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. Key Responsibilities Vendor Management Serve as the primary point of contact for all external vendors collaborating with myTomorrows within the Global Access function. Support procurement efforts during vendor RFP processes, including requirements scoping, proposal evaluation, selection, and contracting. Collaborate with the quality and legal team during vendor onboarding and ongoing maintenance, ensuring all documentation, SOPs, and compliance records are accurate and up to date. Conduct structured regular check-ins with vendors to monitor performance, track program milestones, and resolve operational issues in a timely manner. jobs.title: General Practitioner - 4 Day Week
jobs.description: What is the job? An exciting opportunity to be part of a fast scaling health tech company that’s redefining how patients access care. We are looking for an ambitious General Practitioner to join our growing team and help shape the future of personalised medicine. This is more than a clinical role, it’s an opportunity to combine hands-on patient care with innovation, education, and leadership in one of the UK’s most exciting areas of healthcare. What will you be doing? Conduct video-based new patient assessments to evaluate medical suitability for treatment working closely with the head of clinical services, independent prescribing pharmacists, nurses and consultants. Take thorough medical histories and apply strong clinical judgment to guide care decisions in a time-efficient manner. Act as an escalation point for complex safeguarding issues and help guide safeguarding processes alongside our governance team. Provide advice for complex clinical queries. Contribute to training and upskilling our clinical teams. Ensure accurate and compliant patient records in line with governance protocols. Provide patients with clear, supportive guidance on next steps in their treatment journey. Collaborate across a multidisciplinary team to deliver safe prescribing pathways. Contribute to the development of innovative patient pathways and clinical processes. What do you need? GMC-registered GP with license to practice in the UK. At least 5 years’ post-registration experience. Strong diagnostic and decision-making skills. Comfortable working autonomously in digital-first and hybrid environments. A genuine interest in innovation, health tech, and emerging therapies. Excellent communication skills and digital fluency. Experience in telemedicine or digital health (desirable) Background in pain management, neurology, mental health, or complex chronic conditions (desirable). jobs.title: Consultant Neurologist PAYE
jobs.description: Our patients have often tried everything. Years of appointments, medications that did not work, conditions that slowly took over their lives. By the time they reach us, many have run out of road with conventional treatment. You could be the clinician that changes that. We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultant Neurologists to join our clinical team. About the role You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical call on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is still a young field. The evidence base is growing, best practice is being written in real time, and you will have a genuine hand in shaping it. You do not need experience with cannabis based medicines. You need sound clinical judgement, an open mind and an interest in doing things differently. We provide full specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks, so your time is spent where it matters: with patients. What you will be doing: Providing high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment Conducting patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management Contributing to clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practice Supporting clinical governance and maintaining robust standards of patient care Working closely within a multidisciplinary team of nurses and pharmacists Taking part in ongoing training and development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBPMs) What you need: Full GMC Registration Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification On the GMC Specialist Register for Neurology A genuine interest in alternative therapies Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting Why join us? jobs.title: Clinical Data Manager
jobs.description: General Summary The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US.
